# Migrations that cannot be replayed on a fresh database (35 as of 2026-11-04).
# They fail because the repo history has holes: they drop policies or revoke grants on objects that
# no migration created, re-create objects an earlier copy already made, or backfill specific
# production rows. They are already applied in production, so this does not affect deploys.
# db-tests-pr.yml skips exactly these files and fails on ANY other replay failure, so a new migration
# that does not apply cleanly turns the PR red. Fix an entry by making the migration idempotent, then
# delete its line; the PR check warns when a listed file starts replaying cleanly.
